title: Unctuous Mediterranean Eggplant Bake
description: A vegetarian-friendly, roasted eggplant dish with Italian seasoning and a creamy texture, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Slice the eggplants into 1/4-inch thick rounds and season with salt.
Layer half of the eggplant slices in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with half of the Italian seasoning.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining eggplant slices, then the remaining olive oil, and finally the remaining Italian seasoning.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Add the ricotta cheese and mix until smooth.
Spread the ricotta mixture over the eggplant layers.
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the ricotta mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil leaves and serve hot.
